CLASSICAL_CAN_15bit.name: BCH code optimized for frames < 127 bits

CAN_FD_17bit_le_16B.name: CAN FD CRC-17 (payload ≤ 16 bytes)
CAN_FD_17bit_le_16B.purpose: Higher Hamming distance than CRC-15 over the longer CAN FD frame.
CAN_FD_17bit_le_16B.note: Per ISO 11898-1:2015. Sequence prefixed by stuff-count + parity in ISO mode (CCCR.NISO = 0).

CAN_FD_21bit_gt_16B.name: CAN FD CRC-21 (payload > 16 bytes)
CAN_FD_21bit_gt_16B.purpose: Longer polynomial protects up to 64-byte payload frames.
CAN_FD_21bit_gt_16B.note: Per ISO 11898-1:2015. Sequence prefixed by stuff-count + parity in ISO mode.

nominal_bit_timing_constants.NBTP_register_reset: 0x0600_0A03 → NSJW = 3+1 = 4, NBRP = 0+1 = 1, NTSEG1 = 0xA+1 = 11, NTSEG2 = 3+1 = 4 → bit time 16 tq → 500 kBit/s at 8 MHz m_can_cclk.

data_bit_timing_constants.DBTP_register_reset: 0x0000_0A33 → DBRP = 0+1 = 1, DTSEG1 = 0xA+1 = 11, DTSEG2 = 3+1 = 4, DSJW = 3+1 = 4 → bit time 16 tq → 500 kBit/s at 8 MHz m_can_cclk.
data_bit_timing_constants.data_phase_rate_constraint: Data phase bit rate must be ≥ arbitration phase bit rate (DBTP rate ≥ NBTP rate).

tdc_constants.sum_constraint_mtq: TDC + TDCR.TDCO ≤ 127 mtq absolute; ≤ 6 bit times in data phase
tdc_constants.measurement_start: Falling edge of FDF → res transition on m_can_tx
tdc_constants.data_phase_end: Sample point of CRC delimiter (SSP bit-error checks stop)

key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.rtr_value_REMOTE_FRAME: recessive (Classical CAN only — no remote frames in CAN FD)
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.identifier_constraint_standard: 7 most significant bits (ID-10..ID-4) must NOT be all recessive

rx_buffer_element_layout.R1A_when_TSU_disabled: ANMF (bit 31) + FIDX[30:24] + reserved + FDF (bit 21) + BRS (bit 20) + DLC[19:16] + RXTS[15:0]
rx_buffer_element_layout.R1B_when_TSU_enabled: ANMF (bit 31) + FIDX[30:24] + reserved + FDF (bit 21) + BRS (bit 20) + DLC[19:16] + reserved + TSC (bit 4) + RXTSP[3:0]
rx_buffer_element_layout.R2 .. Rn: DATA bytes packed 4-per-32-bit-word (DB0 bits 7:0, DB1 bits 15:8, DB2 bits 23:16, DB3 bits 31:24).
rx_buffer_element_layout.Rn_count: Per RXESC.F0DS / F1DS / RBDS: 2 (8-byte) .. 17 (64-byte) data words.

tx_buffer_element_layout.T1: MM[7:0] (bit 31:24) + EFC (bit 23) + TSCE (bit 22) + FDF (bit 21) + BRS (bit 20) + DLC[19:16] + MM[15:8] (bit 15:8) + reserved (bit 7:0)

tx_event_fifo_element_layout.E1B_TSU: MM[7:0] + ET[1:0] + FDF (bit 21) + BRS (bit 20) + DLC[19:16] + MM[15:8] + reserved (bit 5) + TSC (bit 4) + TXTSP[3:0]

standard_message_id_filter_element_layou.S0: SFT[1:0] (bit 31:30) + SFEC[2:0] (bit 29:27) + SFID1[10:0] (bit 26:16) + SSYNC (bit 15) + reserved + SFID2[10:0] (bit 10:0)
standard_message_id_filter_element_layou.SFEC_values: 000 disable / 001 store FIFO0 / 010 store FIFO1 / 011 reject / 100 set-priority / 101 set-priority+store FIFO0 / 110 set-priority+store FIFO1 / 111 store-RxBuffer or debug

extended_message_id_filter_element_layou.EFT_values: 00 range / 01 dual-ID / 10 classic-bit-mask / 11 range (XIDAM not applied)

synthesis_generic_parameters.connected_tsu_g: 1 → enables TSU interface; 0 → CCCR.UTSU fixed to 0.
